ruleset.name: 51Degrees Resource Cleanup
ruleset.description:
Fails the build when a FlowData, a Pipeline or a collection of metadata is not closed on every path. The native results in a FlowData and the native metadata collections each hold the engine's data set, so while one is open, closing the Pipeline cannot free the data set. Java never frees the native results by itself.
Where something is closed by its owner elsewhere, such as the FlowData the web integration closes at the end of a request, the code says so with @SuppressWarnings and a comment naming the owner.

rule.name: FlowDataInTryWithResources
rule.message: Create the FlowData in a try-with-resources statement, so its native results are freed on every path
rule.description: Every FlowData created is closed by a try-with-resources statement, unless it is returned to the caller or kept in a field.

rule.name: CloseableIterableInTryWithResources
rule.message: Use the metadata collection in a try-with-resources statement, so it releases the data set on every path
rule.description: Every CloseableIterable a method returns, such as the profiles or the components of an engine, is closed by a try-with-resources statement, unless it is returned to the caller.

rule.name: PipelineClosed
rule.message: Close the Pipeline in a try-with-resources statement or a finally block, so its elements and their data sets are freed on every path
rule.description: A local variable holding a Pipeline that a builder has just built is a try-with-resources resource, is closed in a finally block of the same method, or is returned to the caller.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //LocalVariableDeclaration[not(parent::Resource)] /VariableDeclarator[MethodCall [@MethodName = ('build', 'buildFromConfiguration')] [pmd-java:typeIs('fiftyone.pipeline.core.flowelements.Pipeline')]] /VariableId[ let $name := @Name, $body := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer or self::LambdaExpression][1] return not($body//FinallyClause//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'close'] /VariableAccess[@Name = $name]) and not($body//ReturnStatement/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])]
